meta.description: Three ways members grow every week: prepared speeches, table topics, and roles.

page_hero.headline: Three ways members grow every week
page_hero.intro: Every Wednesday meeting is built around three practices: prepared speeches, impromptu Table Topics, and the meeting roles that keep the room running.

headline: Three ways members grow every week

cards.title: Prepared Speeches
cards.body: Work through Pathways projects at your own pace, from your icebreaker to a keynote. Every speech gets a written and spoken evaluation.

cards.title: Table Topics
cards.body: One question, one to two minutes, no preparation. The fastest way to get comfortable answering a client, an investor, or a room.

cards.title: Roles & Connections
cards.body: Chair a meeting, mentor a newer member, stay for the after-chat. Leadership practice and a network of people building businesses.

roles.heading: Meeting roles
roles.body: Each Wednesday, roles rotate among members. Signing up for one is the fastest way to grow — you get real practice under real time pressure, in front of a supportive room.

items.name: Toastmaster
items.body: Chairs the meeting and sets its tone.

items.name: General Evaluator
items.body: Runs the evaluation portion and evaluates the meeting overall.

items.name: Speech Evaluator
items.body: Provides constructive feedback on one prepared speech.

items.name: Table Topics Master
items.body: Prepares and delivers the impromptu-speaking questions.

items.name: Timer
items.body: Tracks each segment and reports back at the close.

items.name: Ah-Counter
items.body: Notes filler words so speakers can hear them and improve.

items.name: Grammarian
items.body: Selects a word of the day and comments on language use.
